title: 2063. Vowels of All Substrings

examples.explanation: All possible substrings are: "a", "ab", "aba", "b", "ba", and "a". - "b" has 0 vowels in it - "a", "ab", "ba", and "a" have 1 vowel each - "aba" has 2 vowels in it Hence, the total sum of vowels = 0 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 6.

All possible substrings are: "a", "ab", "abc", "b", "bc", and "c". - "a", "ab", and "abc" have 1 vowel each - "b", "bc", and "c" have 0 vowels each Hence, the total sum of vowels = 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 3.
There are no vowels in any substring of "ltcd".
